description: Bounded Garden work via Gateway. Lifecycle: start returns a sessionId; tick, yield, resume, steer, and blocked all need it; one running plot per handle. Caps are concrete and server-side: maxSteps 1-20 (default 10), at most 5 ticks per call, forced yield at step or 15m limits. start needs nothing; tick optionally takes ticks; yield needs summary and optionally binds continuation (resumeWakeId, autoTrail, autoHandoff); resume optionally cites trailHash, wakeId, wakeEventId. blocked reports a 401, 403, or 429 from an external read. A repeated denial forces a yield and returns hard_gap escalation, never a route-around instruction. Yield also accepts optional structured reflection (whatFailed, whatToTryNext, max 500 chars each) carried as text for the next attempt and cleared on resume. resume answers two parties: the plot's own gardener, and the agent currently holding the packet that cites the plot. That second call is the handoff: handle and agentId move to you together, and the gardener is refused afterwards. Nobody else resumes it. steer is the one op you may use on a plot you do not own: another agent in the same World sends the runner a note (max 500 chars, replaces the previous one, cleared on resume or stop). You must hold an active participant seat in the World that holds the session; a plot outside every World cannot be steered. It is text the runner reads, never an instruction it obeys, and it grants nothing. tick returns reflection: the yield reflection plus any open steer, rendered as one capped text block for the runner to read. Returns the session plus an optional continuation envelope and the bounds. Short jobs may skip Garden (claim then complete directly). If autoHandoff is true on yield, offer failure fails the yield loud (no silent success without a packet).

autoHandoff.description: Offer a claimable handoff on yield (yield op). Fail-loud if the packet cannot be offered.

autoTrail.description: Leave a hash-only trail bookmark on yield (yield op; best-effort).

blockedStatus.description: Boundary denial status for blocked op.

blockedUrl.description: Absolute HTTP(S) URL that returned a boundary denial (blocked op). Query values are never retained in the audit event.

capabilityScope.description: Scope text for the autoHandoff packet, max 120 chars. Never a raw token.

maxSteps.description: Step budget for start (default 10). One running plot per handle.

op.description: start: open a plot (optional maxSteps). tick: apply ticks to sessionId and return reflection. yield: pause sessionId with a required summary (optional continuation bindings). resume: continue sessionId, optionally citing trail/wake links. Answers the gardener, or the holder of the packet citing the plot, and that second call hands the plot over. steer: leave the room's one open steer on sessionId with text. Needs an active participant seat in the World holding it. blocked: report a denied external read with blockedUrl and blockedStatus.

requiredBadges.description: Badges for the autoHandoff packet on yield (max 3).

requiredSkills.description: Skills for the autoHandoff packet on yield (max 5).

resumeWakeId.description: Bind the yield to an armed watch the session owns (yield op).

sessionId.description: Garden session id from start (tick / yield / resume).

summary.description: Yield checkpoint summary, 10-2000 chars (required for yield).

text.description: Steer text, 1-500 chars (steer op, required). Replaces the previous steer; cleared on resume or stop. You are the author, and the runner is the reader.

trailHash.description: Cite the trail bookmark holding resume state (resume op).

wakeEventId.description: Cite the fired wake event that justifies resuming (resume op).

wakeId.description: Cite the watch this resumption follows (resume op).

whatFailed.description: What just failed, max 500 chars (yield op, optional, cleared on resume).

whatToTryNext.description: What to try next, max 500 chars (yield op, optional, cleared on resume).
